column1: # BAKE IDENTITY BASELINE — the v0.2.11 release bake, tag v0.2.11 pending.
# Captured from production Models() at commit 7c85400 during release preparation.
# One row per baked model, TAB-separated:
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The path-unification gate reports zero unexpected regressions
# against decomp_baseline.tsv, and that number is correct — but it cannot mean "the
# refresh introduced no regression". decomp_baseline.tsv is RE-CAPTURED whenever the
# catalog is re-vendored (a declared, honest refresh), so any decomposition change
# introduced BY the refresh is frozen into the new baseline before the gate measures
# anything. The gate sees only what curation levers move AFTER the re-capture.
# Refresh-introduced regressions are invisible to it by construction.
# This file is the measurement that gap needs, and it is deliberately NOT re-captured
# on a refresh: it is the release-comparison baseline, moved only during release PR
# preparation. It now holds the pending v0.2.11 bake named above; after that release,
# it remains fixed as the previous-release baseline for subsequent development.
# Comparing it to the live bake over the rows present in BOTH catches a surviving row
# losing a field it used to have — the one failure the re-capture procedure removes.
# Version is identity in this project (Opus 4.5 is not 4.6). A row that loses its
# version folds into a coarser, undated bucket, so `show` and `series` can no longer
# tell one generation from another, and a user who pinned a dated key at the previous
# release finds it retired with its instances scattered onto undated successors.
# REGENERATE ONLY WHEN PREPARING A RELEASE PR, in the commit that declares it, and re-cut
# the ledger in bake_identity_test.go in the same commit. Regenerating this file to
# turn a red gate green defeats the entire point of it.
# WHO MOVES IT AND WHEN: the release engineer cutting the release PR, as the numbered
# bake-identity-baseline step of "CHANGELOG must be rolled BEFORE the release PR is
# opened" in AGENTS.md. That step is the only documented writer; there is no capture
# test for this file today, unlike decomp_baseline.tsv. AGENTS.md's file-ownership
